title: SelfHostedWorkQueueStats

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Number of work items waiting to be picked up

oldest_queued_at.title: Oldest Queued At
oldest_queued_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of oldest item in the work stream (includes both queued and pending items), null if stream empty

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: Number of work items being processed (polled but not acknowledged)

workers_polling.title: Workers Polling
workers_polling.description: Number of workers that have polled for work in the last 30 seconds. Requires worker_id to be sent with poll requests.

description: Statistics about the work queue for an environment.
